current_stage.name: Shared DS2 editorial CTA/handoff convergence after manager CTA normalization
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #806 fixed a confirmed cross-route DS2 handoff inconsistency without introducing a new layout: country detail pages used the secondary manager CTA label 'Помочь с выбором' and /rb/ used 'Обсудить с менеджером', while the existing country catalog and /hot/ already used the clearer canonical label 'Помощь менеджера'. The shared country-detail renderer and /rb/ now use the canonical wording. During CI the standalone content contract was found stale: it still asserted legacy footer selectors despite the current canonical ds2-site-footer. The workflow was repaired to validate the current DS2 footer/social structure and the canonical manager handoff. All 11 PR gates passed, including five-width visual coverage at 375/430/768/1024/1440. PR #806 was squash-merged as 65b7c764698f72c9872fec4cd1563b7621082952. Deploy V2 only and Deploy anytoour.ru completed successfully; the production deploy passed public-page verification, unchanged lead-bridge verification and live-search smoke. Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, lead transport, logo, verified destinations, pricing and unresolved legal/payment content were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Continue the shared DS2 CTA/handoff and wrapping audit at 375/430/768/1024/1440, focusing next on /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, homepage/search and representative country pages. Fix only confirmed inconsistencies using existing approved DS2 owners; do not invent a new layout or interaction without owner approval. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.
